Subject: Good to see you out there
Preview: You've been active lately — here's what's new at Northbay Supply.
Body: Hey,

You've been around lately, and we noticed. That's a good thing.

We won't pretend you've been gone — you haven't. But we did want to check in, share what's been moving in the catalog, and make sure you're set for whatever's next on the trail.

No pressure. No pitch. Just a straightforward look at what's in stock for people who already know what they're doing out there.

Take a look when you're ready.
